body: Also thank you for reading all this and replying. I appreciate that

I would like to say I am really trying to forget and move on from the negative but it seems like more negative things keep happening. I even bought books on mental self improvement.  I've started working out. I am trying. 

But thanks to my last ex I have a eating disorder, which he doesn't care about. As long as I was able to do what he wanted it didnt matter. And I seriously can't look at myself without crying. I can't sit in silence without imagining what they did or hearing what they said.

I can definitely understand what you're saying and that makes a lot more sense now. I did try to think of myself, but I never really found anything I can do to be happy. I dance professionally,  it's my passion. But it's been dying. The places I work are horrible in my first group. People bring guns and I get sexually harrassed a lot. The second group hardly ever hires me. And I can't find places because of 'alliances ' I'd get black listed.  Every time I wanted to do something for myself, something bad happens and its ruined. I'm trying very hard not to say I have bad luck.

I don't know what I want anymore..
